company.name: Adfone, Inc - Ad Based Loyalty and Monetisation Platform

positions.title: Devops/Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a CRM system written for agents to manage and sell healthcare packages to clients implemented using a Django API with realtime elements using Django Channels (websockets) and an Angular 5 frontend. Maintained and oversaw production deployment systems using docker and docker-machine as well as customized and deployed several servers with multiple instances of the CRM and related programs in a loadbalanced/high availabilty setup.
Oversaw datacenter migration and bought/reconfigured servers for the move and setup monitoring systems using netdata, prometheus and grafana as well as elastic search and kibana. Setup a continuous testing integration and testing server using buildbot.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Informed Traveler Program and Applications (ITPA) – Java, Python, JavaScript


- Developed scheduled data scrapping and parsing with Python using tools like the Django Rest Framework and Celery task queues.

- Designed a RESTful Spring API.

- Deployed using Ansible and Docker containers.

projects.title: Ansible-Lookup-Pass
projects.description: An ansible lookup plugin for retrieving passwords from the pass-store. Using Python and Bash.
